manifest.description: This file. Discovery index. Regenerated on every push.

latest.description: Rich snapshot of the most-recent main-merge benchmark run.

history.description: Slim rolling history of soldr canary timings and README comparison cache/timing rows. One JSONL line per main-commit.

line_schema.ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run
line_schema.sha: git sha of the main-commit being measured
line_schema.canaries: object mapping canary name -> wall-time milliseconds
line_schema.comparison: array of compact README comparison rows: benchmark, fixture, scenario_key, tool, wall_ms, cache_bytes, provision_ms, provision_bytes (the last two null except soldr cold, soldr#3802)

index_html.description: Human-facing rendered view with Chart.js interactive graphs.

trend_image.description: Static PNG of the canary trend; retained for the Pages historical deep-dive.

comparison_rust.description: Dark zccache-style overlay chart: bare cargo vs sccache vs soldr on a pure-Rust workload. Cold bars are drawn behind warm overlays. Embedded in README.

comparison_rust_c.description: Dark zccache-style overlay chart: bare cargo vs sccache vs soldr on a Rust+C workload (rust-native). Cold bars are drawn behind warm overlays.

cargo-build-medium-warm.description: Immediate repeat of warm build (cargo freshness fast-path)

cargo-build-medium-from-warm-zccache.description: cargo clean + rebuild from warm zccache; 100% hits expected

cargo-check-medium-cross-verb.description: build -> check; pins #758 / zccache#776 cross-verb cache-key regression

touch-no-change-medium-warm.description: Touch all source mtimes; content unchanged; 100% hits expected
